setup.baseline: A deterministic test game with one human and one AI, fixed seed if recoverable, no random events.
setup.variable: One interacting pair of phases per trial (for example production versus movement, or combat versus colonization).

procedure: Record the full visible state at the start and end of a year.
Construct two orders whose outcome differs depending on phase order (for example, a fleet arriving at a planet the same year a starbase completes).
Repeat each trial at least five times with the same save and settings.
Record the year, order, outcome and any message ordering.
Do not claim a phase order from a single ambiguous result; use a matrix of discriminating trials.
unresolved: The overall order of production, research, construction completion, fleet movement, colonization, combat, bombing, mine decay, packet arrival, scanning, terraforming and AI planning is not recovered.
The RNG algorithm, seed and consumption order are unknown.
The help gives intra-phase constraints but not a global pipeline.
notes: This scenario is a measurement plan; it does not prescribe an order.
